The [[Unidentified Zabrak Sith's armor|armor]] of a legendary '''[[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]''' was buried in his [[Unidentified Zabrak Sith's tomb|tomb]] on [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]] until it was recovered during the [[Galactic War]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Renegade's Aegis}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Update 4.1. that altered the text of many Crew Skill missions to make them faction-neutral changed the Zabrak Sith to a Zabrak warrior.
